root_causes.root_cause: RFC-029 D3 fence stripping in route_and_extract_flat (helpers.py:2720-2726) strips ALL content inside fenced code blocks. Docling wraps substantial Arabic document content in fenced blocks for the MOU document, causing 89% content loss (166 nodes/13564 chars -> 20 nodes/1487 chars). The garble gate misfire (ratio=1.00) is a CONSEQUENCE: the truncated preamble has concentrated mixed-script patterns that trip _has_sparse_mojibake or _is_garbled_blob checks which were diluted in the full-length text.
root_causes.code_path: helpers.py:route_and_extract_flat -> fence stripping loop (in_fence toggle on ``` lines) -> all fenced content silently dropped
root_causes.suggested_fix: Change fence stripping from content-dropping to delimiter-only stripping: instead of skipping ALL lines inside fences, skip only the ``` delimiter lines themselves and let the enclosed content fall through to the normal prose/table parsers. Alternatively, add a content-length guard: only strip fenced blocks below a character threshold (e.g. <50 chars) that are likely formatting noise, preserving substantial content blocks.

root_causes.root_cause: _garble_check_nodes (helpers.py:1153-1186) only inspects node.get('text'), never node.get('title'). RTL-reversed titles (23/24 nodes in سياسة حوكمة) are invisible to the garble gate. classify_verdict also uses _tree_is_garbled which flattens only text fields via _flatten_tree_text. The garble gate has zero coverage of the title field, making title-level corruption a permanent blind spot.
root_causes.suggested_fix: Extend _garble_check_nodes to also check node.get('title') for garble/RTL-reversal. Add title text to the _flatten_tree_text concatenation (or a separate title-aware flatten). Wire the existing _word_has_reversed_morphology check into the title inspection path so reversed Arabic titles are detected.

root_causes.root_cause: _check_bidi_coherence (helpers.py) is defined TWICE (lines 936 and 1028) but never called from any pipeline path. RFC-029 D0 intended this function to detect visual-order Arabic (reversed morphology) as a validate_tree gate, but the wiring was never completed. Both documents in this cluster would benefit from bidi coherence checking - the MOU for detecting reversed Arabic in body text, and سياسة حوكمة for detecting reversed Arabic in titles.
root_causes.code_path: helpers.py:_check_bidi_coherence (dead code, defined twice, never called)
root_causes.suggested_fix: Remove the duplicate definition. Wire the single _check_bidi_coherence into validate_tree as an additive gate (after _tree_is_rtl_reversed), returning (False, 'visual_order_garble') when the check fails. Add 'visual_order_garble' to the client.py flat-routing whitelist if bidi-incoherent docs should fall back to flat rather than ERROR.
